title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double With Towel Bar Solid Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized bathroom storage with this wall mount glass shelf featuring two tiers and an integrated towel bar. From the Waverly Place collection, it combines 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with solid brass hardware, and a gallery rail helps keep toiletries and accessories from sliding.

Highlights:
- Double glass shelf (2-tier) design for bathroom storage and display
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for safety and strength
- Solid brass hardware with solid brass gallery rail to help secure items
- Integrated towel bar for hand towels or washcloths
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look

Specs:
- Dimensions: 16-inch length x 5-inch width x 12-inch height; 5-inch projection
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Assembly required: no
- Included items: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Pairs well with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories in the Waverly Place collection.

Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
